summary.question: 华东和华南上个月的订单数对比

payload.question: 华东和华南上个月的订单数对比

metrics.label: 订单数
metrics.description: 已支付订单数（含之后退款的订单，不含已取消订单）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），订单数最高的区域是华东（426 单），最低的是华南（265 单）。

queries.title: 订单数
queries.sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name IN ('华东', '华南')
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    region_name
  FROM regions
) AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name IN ('华东', '华南')
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
